title: Home Row: F and J
description: Learn the home row anchors. Place your left index finger on F and right index finger on J. These are your home keys.

exercises.text: fj fj fj jf jf jf fjfj

reviewMaterial: Keep index fingers on F and J. Feel the small bumps under your fingertips.

title: Home Row: A and ;
description: Add the outer home row keys. Left pinky on A, right pinky on semicolon.
reviewMaterial: Pinkies rest lightly on A and ;. Do not press hard.

title: Home Row: S and L
description: Introduce S and L. Left ring finger on S, right ring finger on L.

exercises.text: ss ll ss ll sl ls slsl

reviewMaterial: Ring fingers stay on S and L. Return to home position after each key.

title: Home Row: D and K
description: Add D and K. Left middle finger on D, right middle finger on K.

exercises.text: dd kk dd kk dk kd dkdk

reviewMaterial: Middle fingers on D and K form the center of the home row.

title: Full Home Row Left Hand
description: Practice the entire left home row: A S D F.

exercises.text: aa ss dd ff as df sa fd

reviewMaterial: Keep all four left fingers resting on A S D F.

title: Full Home Row Right Hand
description: Practice the entire right home row: J K L ;

exercises.text: jj kk ll ;; jk l; kj ;l

reviewMaterial: Right hand rests on J K L ;. Index finger feels the J bump.

title: Home Row Combined
description: Combine both hands on the full home row.

exercises.text: aj sk dl f; ja ks ld ;f
asdf jkl; asdf jkl; asdf jkl;

reviewMaterial: Both hands stay on home row. Look at the screen, not the keyboard.

title: Home Row Patterns
description: Build rhythm with alternating and same-hand patterns.

exercises.text: fj fj fj dk dk dk sl sl sl a; a; a;
af af af sj sj sj dk dk dk l; l; l;
fad fad fad jak jak jak; sal sal sal
asdf jkl; fjdk sla; asdf jkl;
a s d f j k l ; a s d f j k l ;

reviewMaterial: Focus on even timing. Accuracy first, speed later.

title: Home Row Words
description: Type short words using only home row keys.

exercises.text: as as as dad dad dad sad sad sad
all all all fall fall fall flask flask
ask ask ask salad salad salad
a lad; a lad; all lads; all lads;
dad asks; dad asks; a sad lad falls;

reviewMaterial: Space bar is pressed with either thumb. Keep other fingers on home keys.

title: Foundation Review
description: Review and strengthen all home row skills before moving on.

exercises.text: fj dk sl a; fj dk sl a; asdf jkl;
a sad lad; a sad lad; dad asks all;
all falls; ask dad; a flask; salad;
asdf jkl; a sad lad falls; dad asks;

reviewMaterial: You have completed the foundation. Always return fingers to home row after every key.
